newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firms, volumes thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firms, volumes thin.

text.p: NWE jet fuel strengthened in line with benchmark futures on Wednesday but volumes were muted and premiums steady to slightly easier, traders said.
Dec IPE gas oil futures traded up $4.75 at $215.50 a tonne, supported by cold weather in the U.S. Great Lakes region and northwest Europe.

A barge was traded at around Dec IPE +$30 basis Antwerp, down from Tuesday's talked levels of Dec +$31. Cargo trade was slowed by tight shipping avails and traders dealing with larger, inflexible parcels. Cargoes were again put notionally at Dec IPE +$32 cif NWE.
